nameEn: Manufacture of medical and dental instruments and supplies
description: This class includes the manufacture of medical, surgical, dental and veterinary instruments and supplies.
includes: manufacture of surgical and medical instruments: scalpels, forceps, clamps, retractors
manufacture of syringes, needles, catheters, cannulae
manufacture of dental instruments and supplies: drills, dental chairs, amalgam, dental wax
manufacture of orthopaedic and prosthetic appliances: artificial limbs, joints, orthopaedic supports
manufacture of eyeglasses and spectacle frames
manufacture of ophthalmic goods: magnifying glasses for reading
manufacture of wheelchairs and other invalid carriages
manufacture of stretchers, operating tables, hospital beds with mechanical fittings
manufacture of first-aid boxes and kits
manufacture of stethoscopes, blood pressure measuring instruments
excludes: manufacture of irradiation, electromedical and electrotherapeutic equipment, see 2660
manufacture of measuring and testing instruments, see 2651
